column1: # dry-run.tsv — SYNTHETIC per-(task,model) result records for the model bench dry-run.
# THIS FILE IS SYNTHETIC AND CARRIES NO REAL CARD CONTENT. Task ids here (t-easy-01, ...) are
# invented, not derived from the private kanban board, so this file is safe to commit and lets
# `bench-run.sh --dry-run` (the DEFAULT) produce a complete Pareto table with ZERO model calls
# and ZERO spend. A real run replaces these fixture rows with measured records from real tasks.
# It is shaped to exercise the Pareto logic honestly: sonnet matches opus on outcome for LESS
# money and time (so opus comes out DOMINATED — the actual shape of Uber's own finding, that the
# strongest model often is not worth it on your real workload), while haiku is cheapest but fails
# more (so it stays on the frontier as the low-cost/low-quality corner, not dominated).
# Columns (TAB-separated): task_id  difficulty  model_id  outcome  duration_s  input_tokens  output_tokens
#   outcome in { pass | fail | timeout | error }
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
